# Teacher Guide — Priya S. (FICTIONAL DEMO DATA) (2026-08-13)

*Draft for professional review — generated by CaseCraft.*

**Situation:** Contribute one idea in a group setting, with a pre-assigned role, no more than 2 prompts

## Snapshot
Priya S. (FICTIONAL DEMO DATA) communicates best in writing and in structured settings. She is highly articulate in class discussions
but goes quiet in unstructured social time. She masks heavily — copying peers to blend in — then exhausts.

## What to expect
- May go quiet and stop participating when the class is asked to "work together" without assigned roles.
- Will not ask for help in front of peers — she perceives it as exposure. She asks questions by email or after class instead.
- A neutral correction ("try again") can be heard as failure — she needs feedback framed as process, not judgement.

## What helps
- Assign a specific role in group work — "You are the note-taker" works; "work together" does not.
- Give feedback privately — written comments on work, or a quiet word after class, never in front of peers.
- Warn about changes in advance — even small ones (room change, supply teacher). A note in her planner the day before prevents escalation.
- Allow sketching during listening tasks — it regulates her and does not mean she isn't paying attention.

## What to avoid
- Public praise or correction in front of the class — this causes visible distress, then withdrawal.
- Ambiguous instructions like "be creative" or "work together" — she freezes and produces nothing.
- Assuming she is fine because she seems fine — she masks heavily and exhausts at home.

## Language to use (same words as the family report)
> "Take a minute, then write it down."

## Warning signs
- Going quiet and dropping eye contact during group activities.
- Erasing or restarting written work repeatedly.
- Sitting at the edge of the group, not joining the discussion.

## Escalation plan
If the signs above persist, offer the script once, then the break option. Contact:
____ (fill in the school contact) if support is needed.
